name: open-generative-ai
description: Open-source alternative to HF AI — AI image, video, cinema and lip sync studio

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:workflow && npm run build:agent && npm run build:design && npm run build:studio
scripts.setup: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm install && npm run build:packages
scripts.cloudflare:build: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false next@16.4.2 @opennextjs/cloudflare@1.20.12 wrangler@4 && npm run build:packages && npx opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.test:wallet: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_wallet_schema.py -v && node --test tests/wallet-sandbox.test.mjs && node --test tests/paypal-webhook-registration.test.mjs && node scripts/check-wallet-syntax.mjs && npm run test:realizo-auth
scripts.wallet:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply WALLETS_DB --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --local
scripts.wallet:migrate:sandbox: node scripts/check-sandbox-isolation.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply WALLETS_DB --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --remote
scripts.wallet:migrations:sandbox: node scripts/check-sandbox-isolation.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations list WALLETS_DB --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --remote
scripts.wallet:check:sandbox: node scripts/check-sandbox-isolation.mjs && wrangler d1 execute WALLETS_DB --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --remote --file setup/VERIFICAR-D1.sql
scripts.cloudflare:build:sandbox: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false next@16.4.2 @opennextjs/cloudflare@1.20.12 wrangler@4 && npm run build:packages && opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.test:realizo-auth: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_realizo_identity_schema.py' -v && node --test tests/realizo-native-auth.test.mjs && node scripts/check-realizo-auth-sandbox.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:build:realizo-auth-sandbox: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false next@16.4.2 @opennextjs/cloudflare@1.20.12 wrangler@4 && npm run build:packages && opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.auth-sandbox.jsonc
